meta.defaultDescription: Luxury sweaters, moleskin, corduroy, and tattersall shirts. A fast, responsive online boutique for countryside heritage and modern style.
meta.ogDescription: YCompany luxury apparel with instant search, inventory-aware cart, and secure Stripe checkout.

footer.copyright: © {year} YCompany. Luxury apparel crafted for countryside and city.

about.title: About us
about.metaDescription: Learn about YCompany—heritage countryside fashion, quality materials, and a modern boutique experience built for every landscape.
about.intro: YCompany brings together countryside heritage and modern style in a curated collection of luxury apparel, shoes, and accessories.
about.heritageBody: Founded on the belief that great clothing should feel at home in the field and the city, YCompany is known for sweaters, moleskin, corduroy, and tattersall shirts—pieces shaped by tradition and refined for today.
about.craftBody: We work with trusted mills and makers to source durable fabrics and thoughtful details. Every garment is chosen for comfort, longevity, and the kind of quiet quality that wears in, not out.
about.promiseBody: From instant search and live inventory to secure checkout, our boutique is designed to be fast, responsive, and transparent—so you can shop with confidence, whether you are dressing for a country weekend or a weekday in town.

home.headline: Luxury fashion for every landscape.
home.subhead: YCompany is celebrated for sweaters, moleskin, corduroy, and tattersall shirts—now with a fast, responsive boutique built for phones, tablets, and desktop.
home.featuredBody: High-quality clothing, shoes, and accessories with live inventory, instant search, and secure checkout.
